```go
import "github.com/c2fo/vfs/v7/utils"
```

<a name="ErrBadAbsFilePath"></a>

```go
var (
    // ErrBadAbsFilePath is returned when a file path is not absolute
    ErrBadAbsFilePath = errors.New("absolute file path is invalid - must include leading slash and may not include trailing slash")
    // ErrBadRelFilePath is returned when a file path is not relative
    ErrBadRelFilePath = errors.New("relative file path is invalid - may not include leading or trailing slashes")
    // ErrBadAbsLocationPath is returned when a file path is not absolute
    ErrBadAbsLocationPath = errors.New("absolute location path is invalid - must include leading and trailing slashes")
    // ErrBadRelLocationPath is returned when a file path is not relative
    ErrBadRelLocationPath = errors.New("relative location path is invalid - may not include leading slash but must include trailing slash")
    // ErrBadPrefix is returned when a prefix is not relative or ends in / or is empty
    ErrBadPrefix = errors.New("prefix is invalid - may not include leading or trailing slashes and may not be empty")
)
```

<a name="AbortWrite"></a>
## func AbortWrite

```go
func AbortWrite(w io.Writer, err error)
```

AbortWrite calls WriteAborter.AbortWrite when err is non\-nil and w implements WriteAborter. Otherwise it does nothing. Callers streaming from a fallible reader into an s3 or gs file \(for example with io.Copy and a deferred Close\) can call AbortWrite on copy failure so Close does not commit a partial object.

<a name="BeginSequentialWrite"></a>
## func BeginSequentialWrite

```go
func BeginSequentialWrite(w io.Writer) (end func())
```

BeginSequentialWrite calls SequentialWriter.BeginSequentialWrite when w implements it. Otherwise it does nothing. The returned function is always non\-nil and should be called, typically with defer, when the write stream is done.

<a name="PathToURI"></a>
## func PathToURI

```go
func PathToURI(p string) (string, error)
```

PathToURI takes a relative or absolute path and returns an OS URI. We assume non\-scheme path is an OS File or Location. We assume URI authority is empty. We assume relative paths are relative to the pwd \(program's working directory\)

/absolute/path/to/file.txt : file:///absolute/path/to/file.txt /some/absolute/path/ : file:///absolute/path/ relative/path/to/file.txt : file:///absolute/path/with/relative/path/to/file.txt relative/path/ : file:///absolute/path/with/relative/path/

<a name="SeekTo"></a>
## func SeekTo

```go
func SeekTo(length, position, offset int64, whence int) (int64, error)
```

SeekTo is a helper function for Seek. It takes the current position, offset, whence, and length of the file and returns the new position. It also checks for invalid offsets and returns an error if one is found.

<a name="TouchCopy"></a>
## func TouchCopy

```go
func TouchCopy(writer io.Writer, reader io.Reader) error
```

TouchCopy is a wrapper around io.Copy which ensures that even empty source files \(reader\) will get written as an empty file. It guarantees a Write\(\) call on the target file.

Deprecated: Use TouchCopyBuffer Instead

<a name="TouchCopyBuffered"></a>
## func TouchCopyBuffered

```go
func TouchCopyBuffered(writer io.Writer, reader io.Reader, bufferSize int) (err error)
```

TouchCopyBuffered is a wrapper around io.CopyBuffer which ensures that even empty source files \(reader\) will get written as an empty file. It guarantees a Write\(\) call on the target file. bufferSize is in bytes and if is less than TouchCopyMinBufferSize will result in a buffer of size TouchCopyMinBufferSize bytes. If bufferSize is \> TouchCopyMinBufferSize it will result in a buffer of size bufferSize bytes

When writer is an s3 or gs file that has not been written, seeked or read yet, the copy streams to the remote without a local temporary file, and a mid\-copy read or write failure abandons the upload so Close will not commit a partial object. Such a file cannot be sought or read until it is closed, so callers must Close writer after the copy, as every VFS CopyToFile implementation does.

<a name="SequentialWriter"></a>
## type SequentialWriter

SequentialWriter is implemented by files that stage writes locally \(for example s3 and gs\) and can skip that staging when the caller promises one sequential write stream followed by Close.

```go
type SequentialWriter interface {
    // BeginSequentialWrite tells the file that a single sequential write stream is about to start and that it will not
    // be sought or read until it is closed. It returns a function that ends the hint, which is always non-nil and safe
    // to call even when the file ignored the hint (for example because it was already written to).
    BeginSequentialWrite() (end func())
}
```

<a name="WriteAborter"></a>
## type WriteAborter

WriteAborter is implemented by files \(for example s3 and gs\) whose in\-flight upload can be abandoned when a caller's write stream stops early with an error, so a subsequent Close reports err instead of committing a truncated object.

```go
type WriteAborter interface {
    // AbortWrite abandons any active write session on the file and latches err so subsequent operations and Close
    // report it without committing partial data. It is a no-op when err is nil or no write has started.
    AbortWrite(err error)
}
```
